segments.text:
V. 31.
When the Son of Man ſhall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him—With what Majeſty and Grandeur does our LORD here ſpeak of Himſelf! Giving us one of the nobleſt Inſtances of the true Sublime. Indeed not many Deſcriptions in the ſacred Writings themſelves, ſeem to equal this. Methinks we can hardly read it, without imagining ourſelves before the awful Tribunal it deſcribes.
